title: 第 4 章 你好未婚夫，我是来退婚的
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

双脚落地感受到踩实地的安全感，昭杺柠先是低头，看见单手揽抱在她腰上的手正好快速收回。

“谢谢啊。”昭杺柠一边道谢又一边抬头，才看清救自己的人是谁。

【宿主，就是这个距离，你抬手就能扇钟离珟一巴掌】

系统见准机会提醒。

昭杺柠无视系统的话，想着魔尊保镖不行，她还有个剑修当保镖啊。

而且剑修钟离珟可是仙门弟子。

是正派，不像是百里魇跟她种族不合。

“多谢这位仙者救……”

昭杺柠扬起笑，想着跟钟离珟友好打招呼，就见钟离珟拔剑，凌冽剑刃横贴在她脖子。

“仙……仙者这是何意？”刚被救，就被拿剑架在颈边，昭杺柠疑惑。

“自己说，你和那个魔族，是什么关系。”钟离珟含笑的目光审视落在昭杺柠身上。

“能是什么关系？举报者和被举报者的关系啊。”昭杺柠连忙举起双手。

“小师叔。”

刚刚去追杀百里魇的弟子也跑了过来。

这位弟子帮昭杺柠解释：“小师叔，有魔族伪装乞丐想要混入问天宗，多亏了这位姑娘发现呢。”

“哦？”钟离珟扬眉一笑，目光看向昭杺柠依旧审视：“是你发现的那个魔族？”

“对啊，就是我发现那个魔族的。”昭杺柠连连点头：“那个魔族被我揭发恼羞成怒，还想杀我。”

“那为什么没将你杀死？”钟离珟冷笑。

“你这什么话？”昭杺柠震惊瞪大双眼。

她现在对于这个剑修保镖同样失望。

“我发现魔族后，冒着生命危险揭发他，你们问天宗对我说谢谢了吗？”

“我干个好事我还要被打死才对吗？”昭杺柠一脸怒意质问钟离珟。

“小师叔，那个魔族实力高深，万师兄都追丢了，如果不是这位姑娘发现，这一次怕真的会让那个魔族混入我们问天宗啊。”一旁问天宗弟子也在帮昭杺柠说话。

“这样看来，你跟那个魔族，确实不是一伙的咯？”钟离珟看向昭杺柠的目光依旧带满怀疑。

“我是人类，怎么可能跟魔族一伙。”昭杺柠怒声。

Feeling the sense of security when her feet landed on the ground, Zhao Hao Ning lowered her head first and saw the hand wrapped around her waist quickly retracted.

"Thank you." Zhao Hao Ning thanked him and looked up, only to see clearly who was saving her.

[Host, at this distance, you can slap Zhongli Sui with just your hand]

The system will remind you when the opportunity comes.

Zhao Hao Ning ignored the system and thought that if the demon king's bodyguard was not enough, she also had a sword cultivator as a bodyguard.

Moreover, sword cultivator Zhong Lizou is a disciple of the Immortal Sect.

He is decent, and it doesn't look like Baili Xiang is racially incompatible with her.

"Thank you to this immortal for saving..."

Zhao Haining raised a smile, thinking of saying hello to Zhongli Suo in a friendly way, when she saw Zhong Lizuo drew his sword, and the sharp blade was pressed against her neck.

"Immortal... Immortal, what do you mean by this?" Zhao Haining was confused when he had a sword held at his neck as soon as he was rescued.

"Tell yourself, what is your relationship with that demon clan?" Zhong Lizui's smiling gaze fell on Zhao Haining.

"What kind of relationship could it be? The relationship between the reporter and the person being reported." Zhao Hao Ning quickly raised his hands.

"Little uncle."

The disciples who had just gone after Baili Xiang also ran over.

This disciple explained to Zhao Haining: "Uncle Master, there is a demon pretending to be a beggar who wants to sneak into the Wentian Sect. Thanks to this girl for discovering it."

"Oh?" Zhong Lizui raised his eyebrows and smiled, looking at Zhao Haining still scrutinizing: "Is it the demon you discovered?"

"Yes, I was the one who discovered that demon." Zhao Hao Ning nodded repeatedly: "That demon became angry when I exposed him and wanted to kill me."

"Then why didn't I kill you?" Zhong Lizui sneered.

"What are you talking about?" Zhao Hao Ning's eyes widened in shock.

She is now equally disappointed with this sword cultivator bodyguard.

"After I discovered the demon clan and risked my life to expose him, did you ask Tianzong to say thank you to me?"

"Am I right to be beaten to death if I do a good thing?" Zhao Hao Ning asked Zhong Lizui angrily.

"Uncle Junior, that demon is so powerful that Senior Brother Wan has lost track of him. If this girl hadn't found out, I'm afraid that demon would have sneaked into our Wentian Sect this time." A disciple of the Wentian Sect on the side was also helping Zhao Haining.

"It seems that you and that demon are indeed not the same group, right?" Zhongli Sui looked at Zhao Haining with doubts still in his eyes.

"I'm a human, how could I be with the demons?" Zhao Hao Ning said angrily.
